label: def:polynomial-observable-subcategory
title: Polynomial observable subcategory of a resolution tree
html:
Let \beta be a braid on n strands with c crossings. Let L = \hat{\beta} be its closure. Let \mathcal{R}(L) be the Skein resolution tree (Skein Turing machine). Fix a polynomial bound p(c) = c^d.

Definition. The polynomial observable subcategory of the resolution tree is the full sub-poset

  \mathcal{R}^{\circ}(L, q)
  = 
  \bigl\{
    x \in \mathcal{R}(L)
     : 
    \Gamma_{\mathrm{poly}}\!(x, A_0) \neq 0
  \bigr\}.

The set \Gamma_{\mathrm{poly}}(x, A_0) consists of degree-0 sections at x that the Markov trace computes in at most p(c) Planck steps. This trace restricts to \mathcal{R}_{p(c)}. The poset \mathcal{R}^{\circ}(L, q) forms the computational analog of the physical observable subcategory \mathrm{Bun}^{\circ}(\mathbb{P}(V)) (observable subcategory). It collects the nodes of the resolution tree from which the degree-0 answer P_L(q) is polynomial-time accessible.
